name: PfeifferTurboTC80
description: Implements the Pfeiffer Vacuum Protocol over RS-485 serial for Pfeiffer turbomolecular pumps driven by a TC80 electronic drive unit allowing controling and reading parameters of the pump from arduino. It reqires an appropriate RS-485 to TTL converter with DE/RE direction control for Arduino compatibility. Not endorsed by or affiliated with Pfeiffer Vacuum.
